effects.prompt: Reveal a card with crush from your hand?

_comment:
'When this defends, you may reveal a card with **crush** from your hand. If you do, create a Seismic Surge token.'

Shape follows shipped sup/tough_smashup_blue.json (block card, 'When this defends' = TRIGGERED + ON_DEFEND + MAY); ON_DEFEND is dispatched to the defending card itself (engine.py:1646). Release notes confirm it triggers on BECOMING a defending card and that reveal+token resolve as one optional effect.

The reveal is modelled as LOOK_AT over your own HAND filtered to keyword 'crush' - the handler reads zone/player/filter/into (effect_types.py:3356) and its keyword filter matches card.keywords case-insensitively. The reveal itself has no mechanical footprint beyond gating the token, so peek-without-move is behaviourally equivalent; no reveal event is emitted.

Triage listed SELECT_FROM_REF but it is deliberately not used: WHICH crush card is revealed does not matter (nothing acts on the chosen card), and LOOK_AT's filter already stores every match as a list under one ref. REF_EXISTS handles lists (len > 0), so the MAY prompt is offered exactly when a crush card exists; declining runs nothing ('If you do' falls out of MAY for free per its handler doc).

CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count/player (effect_types.py:1942); json/tokens/seismic_surge.json already exists with slug 'seismic_surge', so no missing token definition.
